title: An Antidote to Dissatisfaction
speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】不滿的解藥（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Everybody's familiar with the feeling that things are not as they should be.
cues.en: Everybody's familiar with the feeling that things are not as they should be.
cues.zh: 所有人都熟悉這種「萬事不如己意」的感覺

cues.text: That you're not successful enough.
cues.en: That you're not successful enough.
cues.zh: 所有人都熟悉這種「萬事不如己意」的感覺 覺得自己不夠成功

cues.text: Your relationships not satisfying enough.
cues.en: Your relationships not satisfying enough.
cues.zh: 覺得自己不夠成功 人際關係不夠完美

cues.text: That you don't have the things you crave.
cues.en: That you don't have the things you crave.
cues.zh: 得不到你所渴望的

cues.text: A chronic dissatisfaction that makes you look outwards with envy,
cues.en: A chronic dissatisfaction that makes you look outwards with envy,
cues.zh: 常常對生活感到不滿 使你對其他人充滿嫉妒心

cues.text: and inwards with disappointment.
cues.en: and inwards with disappointment.
cues.zh: 使你對其他人充滿嫉妒心 並對自己感到失望

cues.text: Pop culture, advertising, and social media made this worse
cues.en: Pop culture, advertising, and social media made this worse
cues.zh: 而流行文化、廣告和社交媒體使該情況更糟

cues.text: by reminding you that aiming for anything less than your dream job is failure,
cues.en: by reminding you that aiming for anything less than your dream job is failure,
cues.zh: 不斷提醒你達不到夢想的工作是多麼失敗

cues.text: you need to have great experiences constantly, be conventionally attractive, have a lot of friends, and find your soulmate,
cues.en: you need to have great experiences constantly, be conventionally attractive, have a lot of friends, and find your soulmate,
cues.zh: 不斷提醒你達不到夢想的工作是多麼失敗 你需要不斷地擁有許多優秀經歷 具有吸引力、擁有很多的朋友 找到你的靈魂伴侶

cues.text: and that others have all of these things and are truly happy.
cues.en: and that others have all of these things and are truly happy.
cues.zh: 找到你的靈魂伴侶 以及擁有這些事物的人們才算真正地感到幸福

cues.text: And of course, a vast array of self-improvement products implies that it's all your fault for not working hard enough for yourself.
cues.en: And of course, a vast array of self-improvement products implies that it's all your fault for not working hard enough for yourself.
cues.zh: 當然，市面上有許多種 自我提升的產品 都在暗示你對自己的未來不夠努力

cues.text: In the last two decades, researchers have been starting to investigate how we can counteract these impulses.
cues.en: In the last two decades, researchers have been starting to investigate how we can counteract these impulses.
cues.zh: 在過去的二十年中 研究人員開始調查了我們要如何抵抗這些想法

cues.text: The field of positive psychology emerged—the study of what makes life worth living,
cues.en: The field of positive psychology emerged—the study of what makes life worth living,
cues.zh: 「正向心理學」領域因此而生 該領域研究什麼事物使生活更美好

cues.text: while cognitive behavioral therapy was developed to change negative feelings.
cues.en: while cognitive behavioral therapy was developed to change negative feelings.
cues.zh: 該領域研究什麼事物使生活更美好 而「認知行為療法」 主要在改善負面的想法

cues.text: Scientists began to ask, "why are some people happier and more satisfied than others,
cues.en: Scientists began to ask, "why are some people happier and more satisfied than others,
cues.zh: 而「認知行為療法」 主要在改善負面的想法 科學家開始問 「為什麼有些人比其他人更快樂、更滿足？」

cues.text: and are there ways to apply what they're doing right to the rest of us?"
cues.en: and are there ways to apply what they're doing right to the rest of us?"
cues.zh: 科學家開始問 「為什麼有些人比其他人更快樂、更滿足？」 「有沒有方法能夠使其他人也變成這樣？」

cues.text: In this video, we want to talk about one of the strongest predictors of how happy people are, how easily they make friends, and how good they are at dealing with hardship.
cues.en: In this video, we want to talk about one of the strongest predictors of how happy people are, how easily they make friends, and how good they are at dealing with hardship.
cues.zh: 「有沒有方法能夠使其他人也變成這樣？」 在這個影片中，我們想討論人們有多快樂、 他們交朋友的難易程度，以及遇到困難時的表現 的最強預測因子之一

cues.text: And antidote to dissatisfaction, so to speak.
cues.en: And antidote to dissatisfaction, so to speak.
cues.zh: 他們交朋友的難易程度，以及遇到困難時的表現 的最強預測因子之一 也可以說是一種讓不滿之心消逝的解藥

cues.text: Gratitude While gratitude might sound like another self-improvement trend preached by people who use hashtags,
cues.en: Gratitude While gratitude might sound like another self-improvement trend preached by people who use hashtags,
cues.zh: 「感恩」 雖然「感恩」很像是另一種自我提升的概念 被那些常用標記的人們所倡導 但我們要講的是 根據大量的科學工作和研究所得到的結果

cues.text: What we currently know about it is based on a body of scientific work and studies.
cues.en: What we currently know about it is based on a body of scientific work and studies.
cues.zh: 但我們要講的是 根據大量的科學工作和研究所得到的結果

cues.text: We will include them in the description.
cues.en: We will include them in the description.
cues.zh: 但我們要講的是 根據大量的科學工作和研究所得到的結果 我們將它們放在說明欄中

cues.text: Gratitude can mean very different things to different people in different contexts.
cues.en: Gratitude can mean very different things to different people in different contexts.
cues.zh: 「感恩」對不同背景下的不同人有著不同的意義

cues.text: It's a character trait, a feeling, a virtue, and a behavior.
cues.en: It's a character trait, a feeling, a virtue, and a behavior.
cues.zh: 「感恩」對不同背景下的不同人有著不同的意義 它是一種性格特徵、一種感受、 一種美德，又或是一種行為

cues.text: You can feel grateful towards someone who did something for you, for random events like the weather, or even for nature, or fate.
cues.en: You can feel grateful towards someone who did something for you, for random events like the weather, or even for nature, or fate.
cues.zh: 它是一種性格特徵、一種感受、 一種美德，又或是一種行為 你會感恩某人為你做了某事 感恩天氣、甚至是大自然或是命運

cues.text: And it's wired into our biology.
cues.en: And it's wired into our biology.
cues.zh: 而這些都與我們的生物學有所關聯

cues.text: 1. How gratitude connects us to each other The predecessor of gratitude is probably reciprocity.
cues.en: 1. How gratitude connects us to each other The predecessor of gratitude is probably reciprocity.
cues.zh: 1：「感恩」如何使我們彼此聯絡在一起 感恩的前身可能是互惠性

cues.text: It likely evolved as a biological signal that motivates animals to exchange things for their mutual benefit,
cues.en: It likely evolved as a biological signal that motivates animals to exchange things for their mutual benefit,
cues.zh: 它可能演變成一種生物訊號 促使生物為了彼此的共同利益而互相交流

cues.text: and can be found in the animal kingdom among certain fish, birds, or mammals,
cues.en: and can be found in the animal kingdom among certain fish, birds, or mammals,
cues.zh: 促使生物為了彼此的共同利益而互相交流 並能在動物界中見到，如特定魚類、鳥類或哺乳動物

cues.text: but especially in primates.
cues.en: but especially in primates.
cues.zh: 尤其是以靈長類動物為大宗

cues.text: When your brain recognizes that someone's done something nice for you, it reacts with gratitude to motivate you to repay them.
cues.en: When your brain recognizes that someone's done something nice for you, it reacts with gratitude to motivate you to repay them.
cues.zh: 當你的大腦接收到某人為了你做了一件好事 它會促使你報答他

cues.text: This gratitude makes you care about others and others care about you.
cues.en: This gratitude makes you care about others and others care about you.
cues.zh: 這種感恩之心使你在乎其他人 而其他人也關心你

cues.text: This was important because as human brains got better at reading emotions,
cues.en: This was important because as human brains got better at reading emotions,
cues.zh: 這點很重要，因為人類的大腦擅長讀出情緒

cues.text: selfish individuals were identified and shunned.
cues.en: selfish individuals were identified and shunned.
cues.zh: 這點很重要，因為人類的大腦擅長讀出情緒 自私的個體會被識別出來並被排斥

cues.text: It became an evolutionary advantage to play well with others and build lasting relationships.
cues.en: It became an evolutionary advantage to play well with others and build lasting relationships.
cues.zh: 與他人良好相處以及建立持久的感情， 成為了演變的優勢

cues.text: For example, if you were hungry and someone else showed you where to find tasty berries,
cues.en: For example, if you were hungry and someone else showed you where to find tasty berries,
cues.zh: 舉例來說，你如果餓了， 而有人告訴你哪裡可以找到美味的漿果

cues.text: you felt gratitude towards them, and a bond to return the favor in the future.
cues.en: you felt gratitude towards them, and a bond to return the favor in the future.
cues.zh: 舉例來說，你如果餓了， 而有人告訴你哪裡可以找到美味的漿果 你會感謝他們，並為了之後要報答對方而建立關係

cues.text: A drive to be prosocial.
cues.en: A drive to be prosocial.
cues.zh: 這就是利社會的來源

cues.text: When you repay them, they felt gratitude towards you.
cues.en: When you repay them, they felt gratitude towards you.
cues.zh: 當您償還人情時，他們會感激你

cues.text: This brought your ancestors closer together, and forged bonds and friendships.
cues.en: This brought your ancestors closer together, and forged bonds and friendships.
cues.zh: 這使你的祖先更加親近，並建立了連結與友誼

cues.text: So early forms of gratitude were biological mechanisms that modified your behavior towards cooperation,
cues.en: So early forms of gratitude were biological mechanisms that modified your behavior towards cooperation,
cues.zh: 這使你的祖先更加親近，並建立了連結與友誼 因此，在過去的感激之情是改變人們的行為 並朝向分工合作的生物機制

cues.text: which helped humans to dominate Earth.
cues.en: which helped humans to dominate Earth.
cues.zh: 並朝向分工合作的生物機制 而使人類統治地球

cues.text: But over time, gratitude became more than just an impulse to play fair.
cues.en: But over time, gratitude became more than just an impulse to play fair.
cues.zh: 但是隨著時間的流逝，感恩變得不只是為了報答了

cues.text: 2. The consequences of gratitude Scientists found that gratitude stimulates the pathways in your brain involved in feelings of reward,
cues.en: 2. The consequences of gratitude Scientists found that gratitude stimulates the pathways in your brain involved in feelings of reward,
cues.zh: 2：感恩的結果 科學家發現感激之情會刺激你的大腦 並產生獎勵的感覺

cues.text: forming social bonds, and interpreting others' intentions.
cues.en: forming social bonds, and interpreting others' intentions.
cues.zh: 形成社會連結 並理解他人的想法 這也代表更容易刻下與回憶起正面的回憶

cues.text: It also makes it easier to save and retrieve positive memories.
cues.en: It also makes it easier to save and retrieve positive memories.
cues.zh: 這也代表更容易刻下與回憶起正面的回憶

cues.text: Even more, gratitude directly counteracts negative feelings and traits like envy and social comparison,
cues.en: Even more, gratitude directly counteracts negative feelings and traits like envy and social comparison,
cues.zh: 不只如此，「感恩」可以抵抗負面的想法或特質 如嫉妒、社會比較 自戀、犬儒主義，以及唯物主義

cues.text: narcissism, cynicism and materialism.
cues.en: narcissism, cynicism and materialism.
cues.zh: 自戀、犬儒主義，以及唯物主義

cues.text: As a consequence, people who are grateful no matter what for tend to be happier and more satisfied.
cues.en: As a consequence, people who are grateful no matter what for tend to be happier and more satisfied.
cues.zh: 因此不論是出於什麼理由，有感恩之心的人們 往往會更快樂、更滿足

cues.text: They have better relationships, an easier time making friends,
cues.en: They have better relationships, an easier time making friends,
cues.zh: 他們有更好的人際關係 更容易結交朋友 他們睡得更好

cues.text: they sleep better, tend to suffer less from depression, addiction, and burnout,
cues.en: they sleep better, tend to suffer less from depression, addiction, and burnout,
cues.zh: 他們睡得更好 較不容易憂鬱、成癮和過勞

cues.text: and are better at dealing with traumatic events.
cues.en: and are better at dealing with traumatic events.
cues.zh: 較不容易憂鬱、成癮和過勞 而且善於處理心靈的創傷

cues.text: In a way, gratitude makes it less likely that you'll fall into one of the psychological traps modern life has set for you
cues.en: In a way, gratitude makes it less likely that you'll fall into one of the psychological traps modern life has set for you
cues.zh: 在某種程度上，感恩會讓你陷入 現代的心理泥沼的可能性較小

cues.text: For example, gratitude measurably counters the tendency to forget
cues.en: For example, gratitude measurably counters the tendency to forget
cues.zh: 例如，感恩顯著地減少了忘掉與輕視正面事物的傾向

cues.text: and downplay positive events.
cues.en: and downplay positive events.
cues.zh: 例如，感恩顯著地減少了忘掉與輕視正面事物的傾向

cues.text: If you work long and hard for something, actually getting it can feel daft and empty.
cues.en: If you work long and hard for something, actually getting it can feel daft and empty.
cues.zh: 例如，感恩顯著地減少了忘掉與輕視正面事物的傾向 如果你為了某事物而辛勞工作 但當真正得到它時卻感到茫然且空虛 你會發現你的情感處於最初的狀態

cues.text: You can find yourself emotionally back where you started, and try to achieve the next biggest thing,
cues.en: You can find yourself emotionally back where you started, and try to achieve the next biggest thing,
cues.zh: 你會發現你的情感處於最初的狀態 並嘗試達成下一個大目標，只為了找尋那種滿足感

cues.text: looking for that satisfaction instead of being satisfied with yourself.
cues.en: looking for that satisfaction instead of being satisfied with yourself.
cues.zh: 並嘗試達成下一個大目標，只為了找尋那種滿足感 而不是對自己感到滿意

cues.text: Or imagine being lonely and wanting to have more friends.
cues.en: Or imagine being lonely and wanting to have more friends.
cues.zh: 或者想像一下你很孤獨，想要有更多的朋友

cues.text: You actually might have someone or even multiple people who want to hangout,
cues.en: You actually might have someone or even multiple people who want to hangout,
cues.zh: 或者想像一下你很孤獨，想要有更多的朋友 實際上可能有一或數人想出門玩

cues.text: but you might feel that this is not enough, that you're a loser and feel bad about yourself.
cues.en: but you might feel that this is not enough, that you're a loser and feel bad about yourself.
cues.zh: 實際上可能有一或數人想出門玩 但是你覺得這樣還是不夠 你覺得你是個失敗者，並對自己感到難過

cues.text: So you might turn down their attempts to hangout, and become more lonely.
cues.en: So you might turn down their attempts to hangout, and become more lonely.
cues.zh: 你覺得你是個失敗者，並對自己感到難過 所以你可能會拒絕跟他們出門，而變得更孤單

cues.text: If you feel grateful for your relationships instead, you might accept invitations, or even take the initiative.
cues.en: If you feel grateful for your relationships instead, you might accept invitations, or even take the initiative.
cues.zh: 所以你可能會拒絕跟他們出門，而變得更孤單 但如果你感恩你的人際關係 您可能會接受邀請，甚至主動邀約

cues.text: The more often you risk opening up, the higher the chance of solidifying relationships and meeting new people.
cues.en: The more often you risk opening up, the higher the chance of solidifying relationships and meeting new people.
cues.zh: 您可能會接受邀請，甚至主動邀約 你越常開啟自己的心扉，則你穩固關係的機會就越大 並結交新朋友

cues.text: In the best case, gratitude can trigger a feedback loop.
cues.en: In the best case, gratitude can trigger a feedback loop.
cues.zh: 並結交新朋友 在最佳情況下，感恩可以引起回饋環

cues.text: Positive feelings lead to more prosocial behavior, which leads to more positive social experiences
cues.en: Positive feelings lead to more prosocial behavior, which leads to more positive social experiences
cues.zh: 在最佳情況下，感恩可以引起回饋環 正面的情緒帶來了更多利社會行為 從而給你更多正面的社會經驗

cues.text: that cause more positive feelings.
cues.en: that cause more positive feelings.
cues.zh: 從而給你更多正面的社會經驗 並讓你有更多的正面情緒

cues.text: This is a common experience after serious hardship like chemotherapy, for example.
cues.en: This is a common experience after serious hardship like chemotherapy, for example.
cues.zh: 這是個苦難後常見的經歷 舉化學療法當例子

cues.text: Life can feel amazing after a crisis is over.
cues.en: Life can feel amazing after a crisis is over.
cues.zh: 在危機過去之後，生活會讓人充滿驚喜

cues.text: The smallest things can be bottomless sources of joy, from being able to taste, to just sitting in the sun,
cues.en: The smallest things can be bottomless sources of joy, from being able to taste, to just sitting in the sun,
cues.zh: 在危機過去之後，生活會讓人充滿驚喜 微不足道的事物也可以是無限的歡樂之源 從能夠品嘗食物、到淋浴在陽光下 或是與朋友談天說地

cues.text: or chatting with a friend.
cues.en: or chatting with a friend.
cues.zh: 或是與朋友談天說地

cues.text: Objectively, your life is the same or maybe even slightly worse than before,
cues.en: Objectively, your life is the same or maybe even slightly worse than before,
cues.zh: 或是與朋友談天說地 客觀地說，你的生活並沒有改變， 甚至比以前更糟

cues.text: but your brain compares your present experiences with the times when life was bad,
cues.en: but your brain compares your present experiences with the times when life was bad,
cues.zh: 客觀地說，你的生活並沒有改變， 甚至比以前更糟 但是你的大腦會將你現在的經歷 與以前很糟的時光做比較

cues.text: and reacts with gratitude.
cues.en: and reacts with gratitude.
cues.zh: 但是你的大腦會將你現在的經歷 與以前很糟的時光做比較 而使你現在更加有感恩之心

cues.text: So, in a nutshell, gratitude refocuses your attention towards the good things you have,
cues.en: So, in a nutshell, gratitude refocuses your attention towards the good things you have,
cues.zh: 簡而言之， 感恩使你將注意力轉移到你所擁有的美好事物上

cues.text: and the consequences of this shift are better feelings and more positive experiences
cues.en: and the consequences of this shift are better feelings and more positive experiences
cues.zh: 簡而言之， 感恩使你將注意力轉移到你所擁有的美好事物上 這種轉變的結果使你有更好的情緒和更正面的經驗

cues.text: While it is great to know these things, is there actually a way to make you feel more of it?
cues.en: While it is great to know these things, is there actually a way to make you feel more of it?
cues.zh: 雖然瞭解了這些事情， 不過有沒有能夠更確切地「感受」到這些事情呢？

cues.text: 3. How to make your brain more grateful The ability to experiences more or less gratitude
cues.en: 3. How to make your brain more grateful The ability to experiences more or less gratitude
cues.zh: 3：如何使你的大腦更加感恩 每個人對於「感激」的程度並不是相同的

cues.text: is not equally distributed.
cues.en: is not equally distributed.
cues.zh: 每個人對於「感激」的程度並不是相同的 你有所謂的「感激特質」

cues.text: You have what's known as trait gratitude that determines how much you are able to feel it.
cues.en: You have what's known as trait gratitude that determines how much you are able to feel it.
cues.zh: 你有所謂的「感激特質」 也就是你能夠感受到多少的感激

cues.text: It depends on your genetics, personality, and culture.
cues.en: It depends on your genetics, personality, and culture.
cues.zh: 這取決於你的遺傳、個性和文化

cues.text: This discovery made scientists wonder if they could design exercises to change your trait gratitude
cues.en: This discovery made scientists wonder if they could design exercises to change your trait gratitude
cues.zh: 這項發現使科學家們納悶， 他們能否設計一些訓練 並改變你的「感激特質」，帶來更多的快樂

cues.text: and lead to more happiness.
cues.en: and lead to more happiness.
cues.zh: 並改變你的「感激特質」，帶來更多的快樂

cues.text: Let's start with important caveats.
cues.en: Let's start with important caveats.
cues.zh: 首先是重要的告誡

cues.text: It's not yet entirely clear to what degree gratitude can be trained,
cues.en: It's not yet entirely clear to what degree gratitude can be trained,
cues.zh: 首先是重要的告誡 目前還不清楚能夠訓練到什麼程度

cues.text: or how long the effects last.
cues.en: or how long the effects last.
cues.zh: 目前還不清楚能夠訓練到什麼程度 或效果能夠持續多久

cues.text: There are no magic pills for happiness.
cues.en: There are no magic pills for happiness.
cues.zh: 變快樂的神奇藥丸並不存在

cues.text: Life is complicated.
cues.en: Life is complicated.
cues.zh: 人生很複雜

cues.text: On some days it feels like you're in control of yourself, and on others, you feel like you're not, and this is okay.
cues.en: On some days it feels like you're in control of yourself, and on others, you feel like you're not, and this is okay.
cues.zh: 人生很複雜 有時候，生活在掌握之中 但有時候，卻事事不如意 並沒有關係

cues.text: Also, sometimes pursuing happiness can make you more unhappy
cues.en: Also, sometimes pursuing happiness can make you more unhappy
cues.zh: 還有，有時候一味的追求幸福 而對自己施加過多壓力，反而會本末倒置

cues.text: if you put too much pressure on yourself.
cues.en: if you put too much pressure on yourself.
cues.zh: 而對自己施加過多壓力，反而會本末倒置

cues.text: Gratitude should also not be seen as a solution to depression
cues.en: Gratitude should also not be seen as a solution to depression
cues.zh: 感恩也不該被當成是解決憂鬱症的方法， 或是專業協助的替代方案

cues.text: or a substitute for professional help.
cues.en: or a substitute for professional help.
cues.zh: 感恩也不該被當成是解決憂鬱症的方法， 或是專業協助的替代方案

cues.text: It can only be a piece of the puzzle; it's not the solution to the puzzle itself.
cues.en: It can only be a piece of the puzzle; it's not the solution to the puzzle itself.
cues.zh: 它應是難題本身，而非解決之道

cues.text: The easiest gratitude exercise, with the most solid research behind it,
cues.en: The easiest gratitude exercise, with the most solid research behind it,
cues.zh: 經過深入研究證實， 最簡單的感恩方法

cues.text: is gratitude journaling.
cues.en: is gratitude journaling.
cues.zh: 經過深入研究證實， 最簡單的感恩方法 是寫感恩日記

cues.text: It means sitting down for a few minutes, one to three times a week,
cues.en: It means sitting down for a few minutes, one to three times a week,
cues.zh: 是寫感恩日記 也就是每週一至三次，每次花幾分鐘坐下來

cues.text: and writing down five to ten things you're grateful for.
cues.en: and writing down five to ten things you're grateful for.
cues.zh: 也就是每週一至三次，每次花幾分鐘坐下來 然後寫下五到十件你感恩的事情

cues.text: It might feel weird at first, so start simply.
cues.en: It might feel weird at first, so start simply.
cues.zh: 一開始可能會覺得很奇怪，所以簡單點就好

cues.text: Can you feel grateful for a little thing like how great coffee is, or that someone was kind to you?
cues.en: Can you feel grateful for a little thing like how great coffee is, or that someone was kind to you?
cues.zh: 你能因為一些渺小事物而感恩嗎？ 像是咖啡有多好喝，或是對你很好的人

cues.text: Can you appreciate something someone else did for you?
cues.en: Can you appreciate something someone else did for you?
cues.zh: 像是咖啡有多好喝，或是對你很好的人 你能感謝其他人為你做的事情嗎？

cues.text: Can you reflect on which things or people you would miss if they were gone
cues.en: Can you reflect on which things or people you would miss if they were gone
cues.zh: 你能感謝其他人為你做的事情嗎？ 您能思考一下有誰或有什麼東西 如果消失的話，你會想念的 並感恩他們在你的生活中？

cues.text: and be grateful that they're in your life?
cues.en: and be grateful that they're in your life?
cues.zh: 並感恩他們在你的生活中？

cues.text: We're all different, so you'll know what works for you.
cues.en: We're all different, so you'll know what works for you.
cues.zh: 並感恩他們在你的生活中？ 每個人都不一樣，你會有你自己的答案

cues.text: And that's it really. It feels almost insulting, like things shouldn't be that simple.
cues.en: And that's it really. It feels almost insulting, like things shouldn't be that simple.
cues.zh: 其實就這樣，沒了 感覺很沒道理，因為未免也過於簡單了

cues.text: But in numerous studies, the participants reported more happiness and a higher general life satisfaction
cues.en: But in numerous studies, the participants reported more happiness and a higher general life satisfaction
cues.zh: 感覺很沒道理，因為未免也過於簡單了 但是在為數眾多的研究中 實驗者花了幾個星期做這些練習後 並表示有更開心，也有更高的總體生活滿意度

cues.text: after doing this practice for a few weeks.
cues.en: after doing this practice for a few weeks.
cues.zh: 並表示有更開心，也有更高的總體生活滿意度

cues.text: And even more, studies have shown changes in brain activity some months after they ended.
cues.en: And even more, studies have shown changes in brain activity some months after they ended.
cues.zh: 並表示有更開心，也有更高的總體生活滿意度 不只如此 研究發現，在實驗結束後的幾個月後， 大腦活動發生了變化

cues.text: Practicing gratitude may be a real way to reprogram yourself.
cues.en: Practicing gratitude may be a real way to reprogram yourself.
cues.zh: 練習如何感恩可能是最能夠重新編譯自己的方法

cues.text: This research shows that your emotions are not fixed.
cues.en: This research shows that your emotions are not fixed.
cues.zh: 研究證實你的情緒並不固定

cues.text: In the end, how you experience life is a representation of what you believe about it.
cues.en: In the end, how you experience life is a representation of what you believe about it.
cues.zh: 最後，你要如何享受人生 代表了你對人生有什麼看法

cues.text: If you attack your core beliefs about yourself and your life, you can change your thoughts and feelings
cues.en: If you attack your core beliefs about yourself and your life, you can change your thoughts and feelings
cues.zh: 代表了你對人生有什麼看法 如果你改變了你自己及人生的核心信念 你就會轉換你的想法與感受

cues.text: which automatically changes your behavior.
cues.en: which automatically changes your behavior.
cues.zh: 你就會轉換你的想法與感受 並不知不覺中讓你的行為發生變化

cues.text: It's pretty mind-blowing that something as simple as self-reflection
cues.en: It's pretty mind-blowing that something as simple as self-reflection
cues.zh: 並不知不覺中讓你的行為發生變化 驚訝的是，像「自我反省」一樣簡單的事情

cues.text: can hack the pathways in our brain to fight dissatisfaction.
cues.en: can hack the pathways in our brain to fight dissatisfaction.
cues.zh: 驚訝的是，像「自我反省」一樣簡單的事情 竟然能駭入我們的大腦，並消除不滿足感

cues.text: And if this is no reason to be more optimistic, what is?
cues.en: And if this is no reason to be more optimistic, what is?
cues.zh: 如果這件事不能讓你樂觀點 那什麼才會？

cues.text: Being a human is hard, but it doesn't need to be as hard.
cues.en: Being a human is hard, but it doesn't need to be as hard.
cues.zh: 做人很難，但並非是艱苦的

cues.text: And if you actively look, you might find that your life
cues.en: And if you actively look, you might find that your life
cues.zh: 做人很難，但並非是艱苦的 而如果你積極地看看四周 你會發現 你的生活比你想像的要好得多

cues.text: is much better than you thought If you're curious and want to try out gratitude,
cues.en: is much better than you thought If you're curious and want to try out gratitude,
cues.zh: 你會發現 你的生活比你想像的要好得多 *汪* 如果你很好奇並想馬上試試感恩日記 我們製作了一個東西

cues.text: we made a thing Please note that you don't need to buy anything from anyone to practice gratitude,
cues.en: we made a thing Please note that you don't need to buy anything from anyone to practice gratitude,
cues.zh: 我們製作了一個東西 請注意，您不需要購買任何東西才能開始寫日記

cues.text: all you need is paper, a pen, and five minutes.
cues.en: all you need is paper, a pen, and five minutes.
cues.zh: 請注意，您不需要購買任何東西才能開始寫日記 你只需要紙、一支筆，以及五分鐘。

cues.text: Having said that, we've made a Kurzgesagt gratitude journal
cues.en: Having said that, we've made a Kurzgesagt gratitude journal
cues.zh: 你只需要紙、一支筆，以及五分鐘。 話雖如此，我們製作了Kurzgesagt感謝日記

cues.text: based on studies we've read, conversations with experts, and our personal experiences with gratitude
cues.en: based on studies we've read, conversations with experts, and our personal experiences with gratitude
cues.zh: 話雖如此，我們製作了Kurzgesagt感謝日記 內容為去年間，我們讀過的研究、與專家間的對話 以及我們個人的感恩經驗

cues.text: over the last year It's structured in a way that might make it a bit easier to get into the habit
cues.en: over the last year It's structured in a way that might make it a bit easier to get into the habit
cues.zh: 以及我們個人的感恩經驗 它的設計方式讓你更容易培養寫感恩日記的習慣

cues.text: of gratitude journaling.
cues.en: of gratitude journaling.
cues.zh: 它的設計方式讓你更容易培養寫感恩日記的習慣

cues.text: There are short explanations and reflections to mix it up and make it more interesting.
cues.en: There are short explanations and reflections to mix it up and make it more interesting.
cues.zh: 書中結合了簡短的解釋及反思 讓閱讀時更加有趣

cues.text: We've also made it as pretty as we could.
cues.en: We've also made it as pretty as we could.
cues.zh: 讓閱讀時更加有趣 我們也盡量讓它精美些了

cues.text: This video continues the unofficial series of more personal, introspective videos
cues.en: This video continues the unofficial series of more personal, introspective videos
cues.zh: 這部影片為非官方的一系列偏向內在， 及省思性的續作

cues.text: from "Optimistic Nihilism" to "Loneliness" and now, "Gratitude."
cues.en: from "Optimistic Nihilism" to "Loneliness" and now, "Gratitude."
cues.zh: 這部影片為非官方的一系列偏向內在， 及省思性的續作 從「樂觀的虛無主義」、「孤獨」 到現在的「感恩之心」

cues.en: We don't want to be a self-help channel, so we'll keep this sort of video at roughly one per year.
cues.zh: 從「樂觀的虛無主義」、「孤獨」 到現在的「感恩之心」 我們不想變成一個自助的頻道 所以只會大約每年一次會製作這種影片

cues.text: We hope they're helpful to some of you.
cues.en: We hope they're helpful to some of you.
